emailConfig.addressHint: This is not a mailbox you log into. Anything sent or forwarded to this address is answered by your agent.
emailConfig.useCaseDirectTitle: Case 1 · Direct email to the agent
emailConfig.useCaseDirectDesc: Someone emails your agent's address directly (or you forward a regular email there). The agent replies as a normal chat conversation — this already works exactly as it does today.
emailConfig.useCaseFormDesc: Set your form plugin (Contact Form 7, WPForms, Gravity Forms, Elementor, etc.) to notify by email, and forward those notifications to your agent's address. GenSmart detects it's a form submission and creates the contact with the visitor's real name, email and phone — not the plugin's technical sender address (e.g. wordpress@yoursite.com). Important: the notification must come from a real plugin address, not noreply@ or no-reply@ — those are blocked to prevent email loops.
emailConfig.step2: In your own email provider (Gmail, Outlook, your domain's mail panel), create an automatic forwarding rule that sends the emails you want answered to that address.
emailConfig.step3: Gmail asks you to confirm the forwarding address: the confirmation code arrives as a new conversation in GenSmart. Then send yourself a test email to check the reply.
emailConfig.fromNameHint: Shown as the sender of replies. Leave empty to use the agent's name.
emailConfig.signaturePlaceholder:

www.acme.com
emailConfig.signatureHint: Plain text added at the end of every reply. Line breaks are kept.
emailConfig.formSeparatorHint: How your website's contact form notifications format each field (e.g. "Name: John"). Only change this if form data isn't being captured correctly.
emailConfig.autoReplyHint: Sent once, right when a new email conversation starts. The agent's own answer follows as a separate email.

faq.q1: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a1: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.q2: What happens when I reach my message limit?
faq.a2: Your agents will stop responding until the next billing cycle, or you can purchase additional message packs.
faq.a3: We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee for all paid plans.
faq.q4: Can I use my own OpenAI or Anthropic API key?
faq.a4: Yes! Enterprise plan users can bring their own API keys to remove all message limits.

pricing.pageSubtitle: Simple pricing. Upgrade when you're ready. No hidden fees.

addons.title: Need More Messages?
addons.subtitle: Purchase one-time message packs when you need them. Non-cumulative, expires at month end.

faqSection.title: Common Questions
faqSection.a1: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade at any time. Upgrades take effect immediately; downgrades apply at the next billing cycle.
faqSection.q2: What happens when I hit my message limit?
faqSection.a2: Your agents pause automatically. We'll notify you at 80% so you can upgrade or purchase add-on messages before hitting the limit.
faqSection.a3: No, message limits reset on the 1st of each month. Add-on message packs are non-cumulative and expire at month end.
faqSection.q4: What payment methods do you accept?
faqSection.a4: We accept all major credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) via Stripe. Enterprise plans can also be paid by invoice.

platform.lead: GenSmart is the platform where you create AI agents, teach them your business and connect them to your channels. Each agent answers, quotes, books and charges inside the conversation, and everything is logged in one place.
platform.h3: Native in the channel, not a link
platform.copy: The agent lives inside the app where your customer already writes. If they start on Instagram and continue on WhatsApp, it picks up where the conversation left off, without asking anything twice.
platform.check1: One memory and one history per customer
platform.check2: Connect WhatsApp Business in one click, no API keys

compare.title: Compared with a traditional chatbot
compare.lead: The difference is not the tone of the replies. It is that the agent reasons over your information instead of following a menu tree.

r1.old: Fixed text in a menu tree
r1.new: Uses your information and reasons out each reply

r2.new: Six channels with a single memory

r3.old: Separate, you have to connect it
r3.new: Included, with lead scoring and pipeline

r5.old: Gets the chat with no context
r5.new: Gets a summary and the full history

compare.cycleNote: Every incoming message goes through the same cycle:

s1.title: Perceives
s1.desc: Reads the message and the history.

s2.title: Reasons
s2.desc: Understands what they want and what stops them.

s4.title: Acts
s4.desc: Acts and logs it in your CRM.

teams.title: One quotes. One collects. One hires.
teams.lead: Quoting, confirming, reminding, answering the same thing. That is the agent work. What needs judgement is still your people.
teams.agentTitle: This is what the agent does
teams.agent1: Answer in seconds, at any hour, on all six channels
teams.agent2: Quote with your prices and your inventory
teams.agent4: Send the payment link and log the sale
teams.agent5: Answer the same question as many times as needed
teams.agent6: Create the contact in your CRM and score it
teams.humanTitle: This is what your people keep doing
teams.human1: Closing the deal that is worth it
teams.human2: Deciding a discount or an exception
teams.human3: Handling the customer who arrived upset
teams.human5: Setting the agent rules and correcting it
teams.linksLabel: The six our customers set up most

how.title: Your agent, in three steps
how.lead: This is the platform flow as you will see it. You can tap each step.
how.step1Desc: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, Telegram, email and web. No code.
how.step2Desc: Upload your catalog, prices, policies and links. The agent learns and speaks in your tone.
how.step3Desc: Switch the agent on and follow every conversation and sale in your CRM.
how.p1Title: Choose where your agent will work
how.p1Note: Tap a channel to turn it on or off.
how.p2Title: Train your agent with your information
how.p3In: Hi, do you have the jacket in size M?
how.p3Out: Yes, 3 left. $189,000. Shall I send the payment link?
how.b1: Do you have the black jacket in size M?
how.b2: Yes, 3 left. It arrives tomorrow in Bogota. Shall I hold one for you?
how.b4: Shipping to Bogota is $12,000 and the total comes to $201,000. Here is your payment link.

how.i4Desc: Sends the payment link and logs it in your CRM.

handoff.title: From the first question to the handoff
handoff.lead: The same conversation, end to end. The agent answers, quotes and charges. When the case needs judgement, it hands it to a person with the full context.
handoff.r1Text: The agent recommends products, answers questions, quotes and sends the payment link. It follows up on carts left unpaid.
handoff.r1Check1: Integrates with your store and catalog
handoff.r1Check2: Scores each lead and places it in your pipeline
handoff.r1Check3: Books calls and appointments with your team
handoff.r2Title: Your team steps in when needed
handoff.r2Text: If the case needs a person, the agent passes them the chat with the summary and history. Nobody asks again what the customer already answered.
handoff.r2Check2: CRM with lead scoring and summaries
handoff.r2Check3: Metrics for every conversation and sale
handoff.b1: Do you have the black jacket in size M?
handoff.b2: Yes, 3 left. It arrives tomorrow in Bogotá. Shall I hold one for you?
handoff.b4: Shipping to Bogotá is $12,000 and the total is $201,000. Here is your payment link.
handoff.handLabel: Example of a handoff to a person
handoff.summary: The customer asks for an invoice under their company name and a volume discount. The agent hands it to the team with the full context.

integrations.title: Connected to your tools
integrations.lead: E-commerce and dropshipping platforms, CRM, payments and calendar. If your platform has an API or webhooks, the agent connects to it. These are examples, not the full list.

faq.title: Frequent questions
faq.q1: Will it sound like a robot?
faq.a1: It speaks in your brand's tone, with your wording and policies.
faq.q2: What if it doesn't know the answer?
faq.a2: It hands the conversation to a person on your team, with the full history.
faq.a3: It handles the repetitive work so your team can focus on what needs judgment.
faq.q4: Is it hard to set up?
faq.a4: You create and connect it yourself in three steps, no code and no tech team.

cta.lead: Set it up yourself in three steps or we build it with you on a demo. Change plans whenever you want.
